Deposit $50 into a DAMM Capital vault on Ethereum and vote on its next reallocation when one opens. Cost: $50 of capital and about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Move a quarter of the vault deposit to a second DAMM Capital vault on Ethereum to show more than one allocation. Cost: about $2 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.

Hold the position for at least 60 days and make one qualifying action each week, so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $50 stays in the position, about $2 of gas a week. Time: 60 days, 10 minutes a week.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page from the link it publishes and claim only from there. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
